name: Outbound Access Protection for Fabric SQL DB
description: Microsoft Fabric’s outbound access protection blocks all outbound connections from a workspace by default and only allows approved external connections through managed private endpoints or data connection rules. It applies across workloads such as Data Engineering, Data Factory, Activator, and Data Agent, giving admins granular control over external connectivity.

result.nameEs: Outbound Access Protection para Fabric SQL database
result.descriptionEs: La outbound access protection de Fabric bloquea por defecto las conexiones salientes de un workspace y solo permite las conexiones externas aprobadas mediante managed private endpoints o reglas de conexión de datos, ahora también para Fabric SQL database.
